newsitem.title: UK: BTR up on stg weakness, Warburg comments.
newsitem.headline: BTR up on stg weakness, Warburg comments.

text.p: Shares in BTR Plc continued higher on Thursday, bolstered by the weakness in sterling and positive comments from broker S.G. Warburg, dealers said.
By 0950 GMT, the shares were up 3p to 263p, but off the day's best level of 266p.
Dealers said the brokerage reaffirmed its positive stance on the stock, but analysts at Warburg were not immediately available for comment.
Dealers said the retreat in sterling also helped.
The currency's strength has raised concerns about the industrial conglomerate's profits, dealers said.
The shares fell by about 12 percent from January 2 to January 15, when the price bottomed out at 236-1/2p.
